At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

For public institutions teams, these are the three workflows we would look at first:

Public institutions: where a pilot could start
  01: Application completeness
  02: Procurement clarification
  03: Inter-office handovers

Our public institutions page puts it like this: “Link applications, supporting records and inter-office handovers. Officials review outstanding evidence and make decisions.” For each workflow it sets out the request, the work, who keeps authority and the evidence that closes the case. There is also a calculator for putting a value on the time at your own case volumes.
